title: Command Keybind Mod
description: Bind any command to any key ingame. Open menu with M key, add unlimited keybinds, no restart needed!
body:
## Command Keybind Mod

Tired of typing the same commands again and again? This mod lets you bind any Minecraft command to any keyboard key!

## Features
- Open the keybind menu with the M key
- Add unlimited keybinds
- No game restart needed
- All keybinds are saved permanently
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

## How to use
1. Press M to open the keybind menu
2. Type a name for your keybind
3. Type the command (e.g. /gamemode creative)
4. Select a key
5. Click Add
6. Done! Press that key anytime to run the command

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 1.21.1
